thesis: PLMR is a high-quality P&C insurer with revenue up 58% YoY, accelerating net income (+27% in Q3), and a high-volume post-earnings breakout. It sits in the defensive rotation that leads this risk-off tape, and it fits the provisional lesson that favors re-rated names near their highs with high rs_63. The bear wins on timing, though: the last price of 167.74 is above the 162.5-165.0 zone, RSI14 is 74.1, the stock is 0.9% under its 52-week high, and reward/risk at the last price is only about 1.17 ((184.0-167.74)/(167.74-153.9)). That is below the 1.5 floor, so this is Hold, and it can be upgraded if price pulls back into the zone, where reward/risk is 1.71 to 2.06.
invalidation: A daily close below the 154.61 swing low (stop 153.9) erases the post-earnings gap and the breakout and voids the long case.
